name: MIB Network Profiles
author: Min Kim
description: Network profiles like macOS Locations: named sets of IP, DNS, IPv6, Wi-Fi and VPN settings you switch with one click, or automatically by Wi-Fi network or Ethernet. Applied through NetworkManager with no root and without editing saved connections.

barWidget.description: Switch network profiles (IP, DNS, IPv6, VPN) by hand or by Wi-Fi network.
